# Mahmood Sultan

> Portfolio of Mahmood Sultan — UX/UI Designer, Web Developer, and IT Student at the University of Toronto.

Mahmood Sultan is a UX/UI designer and developer based in Toronto. This portfolio showcases selected design and development projects, background, and contact information.
